_meta.purpose: Single checklist of A2A v0.3.0 names, shapes, codes and paths. Extracted only from the vendored files in src/Compat.V0_3.Shared/spec/v0.3.0/. Later tasks test against this file.

sources.a2a.json: specification/json/a2a.json at tag v0.3.0 (JSON Schema draft-07)

_meta.refShape: Every entry has specRef = place in specification.md (section number, heading, line). 'schemaRef' = a2a.json (definition, line). 'protoRef' = a2a.proto line. inSpecMd=false means the specification.md text does not state the item itself (types are '--8<-- types.ts' include directives that are not expanded in the vendored file); specRef then names the section that includes or should describe it.
_meta.knownFileCaveat: specification.md embeds TypeScript types by include directives (for example line 305: --8<-- "types/src/types.ts:AgentCard"). The vendored text does not contain those types, so enum values, field lists and kind values come from a2a.json and a2a.proto.

jsonRpcMethods.countNote: 10 methods are JSON-RPC methods (a2a.json A2ARequest anyOf lists exactly these 10 request types). tasks/list is listed separately and is NOT a JSON-RPC method.

methods.note: specification.md 7.8 has no tabbed block; JSON-RPC only, params/result given as bullets (line 1040)
Not in a2a.json A2ARequest (line 45) and not a method const anywhere in a2a.json. Heading has no section number and sits between 7.3 and 7.4. md table row line 218 says 'List tasks (gRPC/REST only)'.

mdInconsistency.text: 11.1.3 names the extended-card method `agent/authenticatedExtendedCard`; 7.10 and a2a.json use `agent/getAuthenticatedExtendedCard`.

restEndpoints.prefixQuote: URL Patterns: MUST follow the URL patterns documented in each method section (e.g., `/v1/message:send`, `/v1/tasks/{id}`).

endpoints.mdUrlNote: 7.3 text is 'v1/tasks/{id}?historyLength={historyLength}' (no leading slash, query parameter historyLength)

restErrorFormat.mdSays: - **Error Format**: **MUST** return error responses in a consistent JSON format that maps to A2A error types.
restErrorFormat.note: No RFC 9457 / problem+json text in any of the three files. specification.md 3.2.3 only requires 'a consistent JSON format that maps to A2A error types' and HTTP status codes '(200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 500, etc.)'. No A2A-code-to-HTTP-status table exists in the files.

sse.quote: If REST transport is supported it **MUST** implement streaming using Server-Sent Events similar to JSON-RPC.
sse.streamEventShape: { message?, task?, statusUpdate?, artifactUpdate? } (7.2 REST response, 7.9 REST response)

grpcRpcs.serviceNameQuote: - **Service Definition**: **MUST** implement the `A2AService` gRPC service as defined in the proto file.

rpcs.note: Named in specification.md only. No rpc, request or response message for it in a2a.proto.

errorMappingClaim.quote: - **Error Handling**: **MUST** map A2A error codes to appropriate gRPC status codes as defined in the proto annotations.
errorMappingClaim.note: a2a.proto has no google.rpc or gRPC status annotations (grep for 'google.rpc' and 'status' found nothing).

taskStates.note: specification.md 6.3 only includes types.ts (line 518). Values come from a2a.json.

mdProseMentions.text: terminal states: completed, canceled, rejected, or failed
state examples in 9.x: submitted, completed, input-required

mdTerminalDefinition.quote: A task which has reached a terminal state (completed, canceled, rejected, or failed) can't be restarted.

roles.jsonDescription: Identifies the sender of the message. `user` for the client, `agent` for the service.

errors.name: AuthenticatedExtendedCardNotConfiguredError
errors.jsonDefaultMessage: Authenticated Extended Card is not configured

serverErrorRange.quote: Reserved for implementation-defined server-errors. A2A-specific errors use this range.

members: data (any, optional: 'A primitive or structured value containing additional information about the error.')

dataFieldNote.quote: ese clearly. The `data` field of the `JSONRPCError` object can be used to provide more structured details for any error.

errorCodes.restOrGrpcErrorCodes: Not defined in the files (see restEndpoints.restErrorFormat and grpcRpcs.errorMappingClaim).

kinds.requiredOnDefinitions: kind is in required[] of Task, Message, TaskStatusUpdateEvent, TaskArtifactUpdateEvent, TextPart, FilePart, DataPart in a2a.json
kinds.protoNote: a2a.proto has no kind field anywhere; Part is a oneof (text|file|data), StreamResponse is a oneof (task|message|status_update|artifact_update).

jsonVsProtoDifferences: Part metadata: in a2a.json (PartBase.metadata); no metadata field on proto Part/TextPart/FilePart/DataPart.
File name: in a2a.json (FileBase.name); no name on proto FilePart.
Message parts field: json 'parts' (Message.parts); proto 'content' (Message.content, a2a.proto line 251).
referenceTaskIds: json Message.referenceTaskIds; no such field in proto Message.

transportProtocol.note: a2a.json AgentInterface.transport is a plain string (examples JSONRPC, GRPC, HTTP+JSON); TransportProtocol is a separate enum definition.

preferredTransport.mdQuote: - **Required declaration**: The `preferredTransport` field is **REQUIRED** and **MUST** be present in every `AgentCard`.
preferredTransport.protoComment: The transport of the preferred endpoint. If empty, defaults to JSONRPC.

extendedCard.quote: Retrieves a potentially more detailed version of the Agent Card after the client has authenticated. This endpoint is available only if `AgentCard.supportsAuthenticatedExtendedCard` is `true`.

jsonVsProtoDifferences: iconUrl: in a2a.json AgentCard, not in a2a.proto AgentCard.
AgentCapabilities.stateTransitionHistory: in a2a.json, not in a2a.proto.

body.shape: Task object serialized as JSON, with kind 'task'. No wrapper.
body.quote: - **HTTP Body (Task object is sent as JSON payload):**
body.note: a2a.json and a2a.proto define no webhook body type; only this md example. The example elides other fields ('// ... other fields ...').

headers.name: X-A2A-Notification-Token
headers.note: Header is introduced with 'HTTP Headers might include' (not MUST). Carries PushNotificationConfig.token.

MessageSendConfiguration.blockingJsonDescription: If true, the client will wait for the task to complete. The server may reject this if the task is long-running.

requiredCapability.quote: Requires the server to have `AgentCard.capabilities.pushNotifications: true`.

jsonRpc.eachDataIs: a complete JSON-RPC 2.0 Response whose result is Task | Message | TaskStatusUpdateEvent | TaskArtifactUpdateEvent

final.jsonDescription: If true, this is the final event in the stream for this interaction.
final.protoComment: Whether this is the last status update expected for this task.

mdExample.closeQuote: _(Server closes the SSE connection after the `final:true` event)._

protoStreamResponse.streamEndComment: The stream should complete when the Task if in an interrupted or terminal state.

extensionsHeader.statement: No HTTP header, gRPC metadata key or JSON-RPC member for extension activation exists in specification.md, a2a.json or a2a.proto.

whatExists.item: Message.extensions[] and Artifact.extensions[] (arrays of extension URIs)
Extension method naming rule: '{category}/{action}' with a clear namespace, e.g. myorg.extension/action

versionHeader.statement: No A2A-Version header in any of the three files; the version is carried in AgentCard.protocolVersion (default '0.3.0' in a2a.json).

fileDisagreements.text: Described only in specification.md (JSON-RPC 'N/A', gRPC 'ListTask', REST 'GET /v1/tasks'). Not in a2a.json, no rpc in a2a.proto.
